title: Supplementary continuous monitoring needs operating strategy evidence
remediation: The sponsor monitoring lead approves a system-level strategy with assessed boundaries, owners, collection and review cadence and recurring security assessments. Verify at least a representative monitored period and assessment follow-up record. Retain dated metric results, evidence of review, escalation and decisions for missing coverage.

milestones.title: Collect the approved monitoring and assessment strategy, dated operating records, and a traced review and corrective action
